changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Add an optional stable link from the canonical BI query dataset to its published ModelSpec owner. Manually created query datasets remain valid with a null link.

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Enforce one canonical BI dataset per published ModelSpec without locking existing unlinked query datasets during index creation.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS uk_query_dataset_source_model_spec ON query_dataset_asset (source_model_spec_id) WHERE source_model_spec_id IS NOT NULL

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS uk_query_dataset_source_model_spec
